Cinematic film still, rainy London financial district at dawn, low wide angle at pavement level: a long line of office workers in wet coats carrying cardboard boxes of desk belongings walk out of a glass tower, while in the same frame men in grey overalls wheel tall black server cabinets in through the revolving doors past them. Nobody looks at each other. Wet reflections, cold blue light, one warm lobby glow. Anamorphic, 35mm grain, photoreal.

Cinematic film still, top-down drone view straight down onto a wet city plaza in the rain: a river of black umbrellas flowing out of an office tower's doors to the left, a single file of server racks on trolleys flowing in to the right, the two streams passing each other like traffic. Cold blue grade, crisp, photoreal, 35mm.

Cinematic film still, an emptied open-plan office floor at dusk, rows of desks with chairs pushed in, one woman in the middle distance carrying her cardboard box toward the lift, while a technician behind her bolts a glowing server rack where a desk used to be. Rain on floor-to-ceiling windows, London skyline beyond. Muted blue grade, shallow depth, photoreal.

Cinematic film still, a glass-walled boardroom at night high above the city, eight executives in dark suits raising champagne flutes, their faces lit from below by a giant wall screen showing a single line chart soaring upward and the words HEADCOUNT -200,000 in white. Expensive, cold, smug. Warm skin tones against blue night. Anamorphic, shallow depth, photoreal.

Cinematic film still, close-up over the shoulder of a chief executive in a tailored suit sitting alone in a dark corner office, a laptop screen glowing with a draft email headed Restructuring, an AI assistant panel beside it, a champagne bottle sweating in an ice bucket by his hand. His reflection faint in the window over a rainy city. Moody, low key, photoreal.

Cinematic film still, a modern sleek trading floor at night, young traders standing and applauding as a wall of screens flashes green, confetti of paper from a printer floating in the air, one man spraying champagne. Glass, LEDs, dark blue and green light, photoreal, documentary handheld feel, 35mm.

Cinematic film still, a small British corner shop at night, a tired young mother in a damp coat alone at the till holding a single loaf of white bread, staring at the card reader showing a price that has jumped, her toddler asleep in a pushchair beside her. Fluorescent light, shelves of tins, rain on the window behind. Quiet, intimate, photoreal, 35mm grain.

Cinematic film still, a supermarket self-checkout at night, an older man in a work jacket with a basket holding only bread and milk, the screen glowing red with CARD DECLINED, an empty aisle behind him. Cold fluorescent light, shallow depth of field, photoreal, documentary realism.

Cinematic film still, extreme close-up of a supermarket shelf edge label for a sliced white loaf, the old price crossed out and a new higher price stickered over it, a hand reaching past it into the frame. Shallow depth, warm fluorescent light, photoreal macro.

Cinematic film still, a modern financial data centre trading room in Canary Wharf at night, a huge curved LED wall of tickers with one line glowing brighter than the rest: BREAD +90%, two traders silhouetted against it, glass and steel, cool blue and green light, photoreal, anamorphic.

Cinematic film still, a giant curved LED billboard on the side of a London tower at night in rain, a scrolling stock ticker reading BREAD PLC +90% in bright green above a crowd of commuters with umbrellas walking past, nobody looking up. Reflections on wet pavement, photoreal, 35mm.

Cinematic film still, inside a vast modern banknote printing hall, an endless conveyor of uncut sheets of new banknotes racing past under bright industrial light, a lone official in a suit watching from a gantry. Clean, cold, monumental, photoreal.

Epic cinematic film still, the interior of a colossal futuristic hangar inside a starship, tens of thousands of identical humanoid robots standing in perfect tiered rows rising like an amphitheatre, every robot wearing a deep crimson hooded cloak, glowing red eyes under the hoods, all facing the camera mid-song with mouths open. A single shaft of white light falls on the centre. Vast, operatic, monumental, near-black with red. Photoreal, anamorphic.

Cinematic film still, low angle medium close-up of the front row of a robot choir, sleek white humanoid robots in heavy crimson hooded cloaks, red glowing eyes, metal jaws open in song, breath-like vapour in the cold air, endless rows of red eyes receding into darkness behind them. Dramatic top light, deep shadows, photoreal, shallow depth.

Epic cinematic film still, from behind a tall dark figure standing on a podium raising both arms, facing an enormous choir of robots in crimson hooded cloaks arranged in a vast curved tiered stage inside a cathedral-sized machine hall, thousands of red eyes in the dark, beams of light cutting through haze. Operatic, monumental, photoreal.

Cinematic film still, a long telephoto shot compressing row after row of hooded robots in crimson cloaks standing shoulder to shoulder, only their glowing red eyes and silver chins visible under the hoods, stretching to the horizon in a dark hangar, red light haze. Menacing, ceremonial, photoreal, anamorphic.

Epic cinematic film still, a gigantic circular arena inside a futuristic machine, rings of robot choristers in crimson cloaks stacked in tiers up into the darkness like a cooling tower, all heads tilted back singing toward a blinding white light at the top. Overwhelming scale, red and white, photoreal, ultra wide.

Epic cinematic film still, aerial wide shot over a vast landing platform at night, an army of robots in crimson hooded cloaks drawn up in enormous rectangular blocks, red eyes glowing like a field of embers, a huge black ship looming overhead with its hangar open and floodlights pouring down. Monumental, ominous, photoreal.

Cinematic film still, extreme close-up of one robot's face beneath a deep crimson velvet hood, polished graphite metal skin, two glowing red eyes, a speaker-grille mouth open mid-note, a fine line of red light reflecting along the hood's edge, darkness behind. Ceremonial, regal, unsettling, photoreal, shallow depth.

Epic cinematic film still, inside a dark stone-and-steel hall of immense height, thousands of robots in crimson hooded cloaks each holding a small glowing red light at chest height, forming a sea of red points rising into the dark, a single figure in the centre aisle, mist on the floor. Ritual, operatic, photoreal.

Epic cinematic film still, a colossal black AI machine the size of a cathedral standing in a dark hall, a monolithic wall of stacked compute modules, its face erupting with dozens of blinding white light beams fanning out through thick haze like a stadium concert lighting rig, a tiny human silhouette at its base for scale. Overwhelming, monumental, photoreal.

Cinematic film still, looking straight into a wall of the brightest white LED blinders imaginable mounted across the face of a giant machine, light flaring across the lens, silhouetted server towers either side, haze, the rest of the frame near-black. Festival-strobe intensity, overexposed core, anamorphic flare, photoreal.

Epic cinematic film still, a vast circular AI core chamber seen from below, a ring of colossal machine pillars converging overhead, hundreds of tight white searchlight beams shooting down and sweeping through dense haze like a headline festival show, red indicator lights pulsing on the pillars. Monumental, photoreal, ultra wide.

Epic cinematic film still, ultra wide shot of an immense black machine filling a valley-sized hall, its surface laced with thin lines of red light, then a single row of blinding white light panels firing at full power across its middle, light spilling across a wet floor, one maintenance worker tiny and silhouetted in the foreground. Photoreal, monumental, near-black.

Cinematic film still, a frozen strobe flash inside a giant machine hall, everything bleached white for an instant: rows of server towers, cables, gantries, haze, hard black shadows thrown long across the floor. High contrast, overexposed, like a single frame of a concert strobe, photoreal.

Epic cinematic film still, the face of a towering AI machine built of concentric rings of black glass and metal, at its centre an aperture opening to reveal a white light so bright it flares the lens, beams spilling out through haze, red warning lights around the rim. Godlike, operatic, photoreal, anamorphic.

Epic cinematic film still, a vast dark hall where a choir of robots in crimson hooded cloaks stands in tiers facing an enormous black AI machine, the machine blasting blinding white light beams back over them through haze, red eyes and white light. Operatic climax, monumental, photoreal, ultra wide.

Cinematic film still, inside an old beige 1990s server room with a single CRT terminal glowing green, the far wall cracked open to reveal behind it a colossal futuristic machine blazing with white light and red seams, beams pouring through the gap and across the dusty room. Then and now in one frame, photoreal.
